_comment: The feeds apps/telematics (hack/demo/tiles/telematics) will keep live dispatch supplied with: the customers' telematics providers and the weather service. The tile is new on the set: seed.sh leaves its net interface for an admin to bind, so the shell shows it under 'interfaces to bind'. It makes no network calls; this list is only what its page shows. seed.sh copies it into the tile as feeds.json.

feeds.name: Samsara
feeds.what: Van positions: Brightwell, Kettle Creek, Bluestem

feeds.name: National Weather Service
feeds.what: Weather alerts for the depots' counties
